newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's Schuessel sees eight early EMU starters.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Schuessel sees eight early EMU starters.

text.p: Austrian Foreign Minister Wolfgang Schuessel said on Tuesday he expected eight countries to qualify for early membership in Europe's single currency and that Austria would certainly be among them.

"I am convinced that, at this stage, ten countries have a chance to take part, but I expect Britain and Denmark to use the opt-out clause and that they will probably join two years later," he told a news briefing.

"Austria will be among the first group, Austria has the qualifications," Schuessel said, adding he was convinced the country would fulfil the Maastricht criteria for membership in Europe's monetary union (EMU) this year.

The treaty sets a range of economic targets to qualify for EMU, including limiting budget deficits to three percent of gross domestic product and public debt to 60 percent. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
